task: Set all eight COST_* pricing and metadata keys in 13-2-narwhal-portal-bindings.sh for both Kakao and Vagrant providers so portal >= 1.1.1 /api/cost does not fail closed with 503, add ghcr.io/aquasecurity/node-collector:0.3.1 to the air-gap image inventory and TRANSIENT_IMAGES, and add seam check R282. Scope of this change: the in-repo provisioning, air-gap inventory, lessons-log and regression check updates; live Kakao changes (patching narwhal-portal-secrets and recreating the pod, mirroring node-collector:0.3.1 by digest) were applied separately on 2026-10-26.

events.summary: Two source gaps behind empty Kakao Portal cost and compliance infra views: 13-2-narwhal-portal-bindings.sh set only the three COST_*_HOURLY keys while portal/src/lib/cost.ts getCostPricing() fails closed (/api/cost -> 503) unless all eight COST_* keys exist; ghcr.io/aquasecurity/node-collector:0.3.1 was missing from scripts/airgap/{images.txt,01-generate-image-list.sh,lib/image-digests.tsv,lib/component-licenses.tsv}. Added seam check R282 and lessons-log entry. No RBAC, chart or portal source changes.

On live Kakao (2026-10-26), APISIX access log showed 25 of 25 /api/cost requests answered 503, and the portal pod had only the three COST_*_HOURLY keys. Meanwhile, ghcr.io/aquasecurity/node-collector:0.3.1 was in ImagePullBackOff because it was not in the bastion mirror. Locally, check-portal-cost-env-seam.py against origin/main 13-2-narwhal-portal-bindings.sh fails on the five missing COST_* metadata keys and eight missing per-provider defaults.
